title: Hello Cube
description: A lit, spinning cube — the smallest complete 3D scene.

title: Bouncing Sprites
description: Eight textured quads bouncing inside a 640x480 virtual frame.

title: Light Show
description: Four colored point lights orbiting a Phong sphere in real time.

title: CRT Bloom
description: A declarative post-effect chain: bloom plus a color filter.

title: Input Playground
description: An interactive tour of the F9 input API: mouse move/down/wheel callbacks paint a particle trail, keyboard events and held-state queries steer it, and surface-pixel pointer coordinates are mapped into the 2D frame. Self-plays until you interact.

title: Texture Showcase
description: A real CC0 paving-stone texture (ambientCG) loaded from the sample's asset pack: shown full and cropped with sourceRect, and tiled across a 3D ground plane and spinning cube.

title: glTF Model
description: A real CC0 glTF model (Avocado by Microsoft, Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets) imported with loadMeshData, base-color mapped and lit under the engine's Phong model.

title: Fox Walk
description: A real CC0 rigged model (Fox, Quaternius' Ultimate Animated Animals) imported with loadMeshData and CPU-posed with poseMesh from a script-owned clock, drawn with skinned: true.

title: Script Modules
description: A lit 3D scene split across files with the F10 CommonJS module system: synchronous require loads a relative module (palette.js), an extension-less specifier with the deterministic .js fallback (orbit), and a JSON module (data/scene.json) from the sample's asset pack, then registers update/render hooks from the composed data.

title: Text Showcase
description: A TrueType font baked into a fixed atlas with the F8a text API: loadFontData -> createFont (with baked outline/shadow) draws a title, a wrapped paragraph whose alignment cycles through left/center/right/justify (Tab), and a live typing area (type, Enter, Backspace). The font is a CC0 Kenney font from the sample's asset pack.

title: Particle Showcase
description: The F11 particle system: an additive fire (view billboards, continuous emission), an alpha smoke plume, a y-axis-billboard ember burst (emit), lifetime-interpolated size/color, plus a 2D drawSprites row. All procedural textures, no asset pack.

title: Water Plane
description: F11 oriented-plane particles: a water surface built from fixed `facing: 'plane'` quads (normal +Y) that stay world-aligned as the camera orbits, with a camera-facing spray and a y-billboard above it.
